capabilities: Resize table columns by dragging column borders
Fit a column to its longest line by double-clicking a border
Save widths per note and table keyed by the header row
Reset column widths in a note via a command
extras: Manual installation only (copy release files into the plugins folder); the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian renders Markdown tables with automatic column widths and offers no way to adjust or keep custom column widths across sessions.
summary: Table editor that lets you resize Markdown table columns by dragging borders in Live Preview and Reading view, without altering the Markdown.
